note: The law every shell on every renderer answers to: a settle re-renders EXACTLY the surfaces its `InvocationResult.ui_scope` names, a scope-less settle (`full`) re-renders all of them, and a `none` scope opens no pass at all. React has always read this (`🛠️ShellHelpers/🟦️.tsx`'s `uiRefreshWants*` + `buildUiRefreshRequest`); the wgpu shell's `refresh_ui` walked every window and panel unconditionally and threw the field away — 116 of 137 renders per converging edit answered `patched=0` and the flow window was re-minted eight times for nothing (ticket 26/09/09/PROCEDURAL-3D-END-TO-END, `📓️wgpu-edit-convergence-perf-2026-09-14.md` §7).

sections.note: The flag-addressed sections of one batched `refresh-ui`. Windows and panels are addressed by BODY KEY instead — two live instances of one window kind share a body key and are selected together, exactly as `sessionWindowInstances` fans them out.
sections.catalogueNote: The app-static operator/palette catalogue has no flag of its own: only a full scope asks the guest for it.

surfaces.note: The generation3d edit-mode surface census a converging preview actually refreshes, taken from `🐍️wgpu-edit-perf-probe.mjs`'s own census.

selections.note: A program that emits no `uiScope` deserializes to `full` on both sides, so today's whole-shell refresh is what an unmodified plugin keeps getting.
A pure telemetry/heartbeat action, and every rejected typed operation.
The measured case: a `flowEvalTick` hop dirties the preview body and nothing else. The flow window keeps the document it already has.
`partial` with nothing named asks for nothing renderable — it must never widen to `full` by accident, which is the exact shape a missing-field default would produce.

unions.note: A second pass asked for while the first was still crossing into the guest owes the UNION, never the newer alone — otherwise the first pass's surfaces silently stop updating.

hostEffectEarnings.note: The scope a dispatch declares is what the GUEST dirtied. What the HOST dirtied by applying that dispatch's own effects is unioned on top, never substituted.

Measured on the puzzle 3d editor (ticket 26/09/02 wave B37): the verb armed `scene.active_utility`, the operation completed with `UiDirtyScope::None`, and the armed body was never fetched — the world pane published `select` for thirty seconds.
Neither names a body of its own and `panelJson` feeds every section, so the only honest answer is `full`.
